title: iberis amara subsp. decipiens
intro: Iberis amara subsp. decipiens, commonly known as False Candytuft, is a plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. The health benefits associated with Iberis amara subsp. decipiens include its potential to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of this plant are believed to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
